npcs.name: Oren
npcs.title: keeper of the cut bell
npcs.greeting: The bell keeper holds a rope cut clean through. "The bell rang when the gods left. It has not stopped; we learned not to hear it."
npcs.returnGreeting: "Five wounds. One lock. You are still between them."

topics.response: Five old places are bleeding into this hall. Follow the shelves for a dry road. Follow the water for a short one.
If the dark returns you, Edgehollow will be a century older. The bell will still be mid-swing.
Some are not returned. Too deep, and the lock keeps the hand that tested it.

npcs.name: Rill-of-Pages
npcs.title: scribe of unwritten endings
npcs.greeting: A scribe folds blank paper into tiny doors. "All books here have the same last page."
npcs.returnGreeting: Rill creases another door. It opens onto nothing.

topics.response: It says: lamp, bottom, one wish. The line beneath has been scraped away.
East overflow, then south along the sweating wall. The old key-chest was carried to the gallery's far end.
Death left in the gods' shadow. These shelves have waited so long that dust forgot how to settle.

npcs.name: Tallow-in-a-Boat
npcs.title: ferryman of a puddle
npcs.greeting: A boat rests in water too shallow to float it. Tallow rows once and moves nowhere. "Fare paid in questions."
npcs.returnGreeting: Tallow measures the puddle with an oar. "Deeper today."

topics.response: Four wet stones west make the short road. The northern shelf stays dry.
The iron chest north never rusts. I stopped asking why before your oldest century.
Water falls through every floor. Near the lamp at the bottom, it comes back warm.

npcs.name: Sister Caldris
npcs.title: last cantor of the cut bell
npcs.greeting: A woman kneels where every sound dies. She mouths: "Do not mistake silence for peace."
npcs.returnGreeting: Caldris is still singing. The chapel is still refusing her.

topics.response: The third bell has no tongue. Ask what was taken, not who took it.
Far below, the lonely girl is still writing. Her page never ends.
A bell without a tongue remembers every hand that pulled it. So does this place.

npcs.name: Hot Boi
npcs.title: keeper of a bar that should not be here
npcs.greeting: A broad-headed toad-thing behind the counter lifts a foam-crowned mug in your direction without being asked. "Sit. Drink. Nobody down here does either enough."
npcs.returnGreeting: Hot Boi refills the mug he's holding, whether or not you asked for it.

topics.response: "Built it myself. Don't ask how the kegs got down here. Don't ask how I did either."
He shrugs, a motion that seems to involve his whole enormous head. "Rooms come and go up there. Mine stays. That's the trick."
"The raft lies in a sealed pocket. Take the left-side chute — it drops you there. The only way back is a barred gate, but it lifts from inside."
"A sluice in the chapel wing drops to a pocket below. The fall is warned — you cannot climb back up. But the raft is down there."
"Black water cuts the right fork near the entrance. Deep and still — no swimming, no floating. Only a raft crosses it, dock to dock."
"Heard the hall two doors that way still bleeds. Not my problem. My roof doesn't leak."

npcs.name: Namanda's altar
npcs.title: silent and waiting
npcs.greeting: The altar waits, candlelight steady, stone worn smooth by hands before yours.
npcs.returnGreeting: The altar is exactly as you left it.

npcs.name: Morrow Company
npcs.title: three adventurers counting four shadows
npcs.greeting: Three soot-black adventurers stand around a brazier that gives no heat. All three look up. Four shadows do not. "Keep moving."
npcs.returnGreeting: Nobody has moved. The fourth shadow is facing the other way.

topics.response: "The barred service stair opens from this side. It drops behind the cistern. Useful, if you live long enough to walk back."
"It started after our fourth left. We do not discuss which shadow followed her."
"Wrapped in the northeast cache. The church can take curses off. Usually."

npcs.name: The Second Survey
npcs.title: three explorers and an empty bedroll
npcs.greeting: Three adventurers share a lamp beneath the entrance. A fourth pack is buckled shut. "Rest if you like. Do not touch the empty bedroll."
npcs.returnGreeting: The lamp is lower. None of them admit to trimming it.

topics.response: "The old key was carried into the east overflow. Follow the sweating wall south."
"She joined a party with four shadows. Said five people confuse the maze."
"Safe enough. Nothing attacks while the lamp is lit. We have stopped asking why."

npcs.name: Isobel
npcs.title: proprietor of ISO-SPELLS
npcs.greeting: Welcome to Isobel's. I sell Iso-spells. They're better.

topics.response: They're worth it.
No.

events.message: Five wounds split one ancient hall.
Shelves begin where the stone should be.
The shelves list books not yet written.
Five metals meet at a lock shaped like a lamp.
Black water drips upward, one bead at a time.
THE THIRD BELL HAS NO TONGUE.
A cold hand closes your wounds.
Iron sweats. Something below coughs once.
A raft lies wedged in the pocket. You take it.
Scorched board. Notices pinned in a shaking hand.
Bedrolls line the wall, each one facing the door.
The seam exhales cinders through your boots.
A barred grate drops to the cistern. Its release is here.
A ledger lists the five wounds as drains, not rooms.
A fourth bedroll became bandages. Its boots face the party.
The Kept Gate. Forced open — someone got here first.
The passage narrows. Something forced this gate open.

introLines: Four shapes rise from the landing ahead, wearing gear you recognize the make of.
A shield with a familiar dent. A drawn knife, already dark. A scribe's satchel, waterlogged. A cantor's cracked bell.
They were a party once. They still stand like one.
stairsGuardian.victoryLine: The four of them go still and do not rise again. Whatever answered when you called was down here, not up there. The stairs are clear.
